group_results.reason: Metadata getters invoke full chunk reading, which reaches the new zero-length eXIf check. In the default nonstrict context, EEXIF is handled by discarding the ancillary chunk. The harness has no assertion requiring zero-length eXIf to be retained.

build.reason: The supplied build script delegates the actual recipe to tests/ossfuzz.sh, which was not supplied. CMake defaults do not establish which recipe that script uses.

input.reason: After a four-byte control suffix, the target supplies the remaining fuzz bytes through supported buffer or stream inputs.

lifecycle.reason: Context creation and the target’s cleanup calls are supplied, but the spng_ctx_free implementation is absent, so cleanup behavior cannot be affirmed.

control_flow.reason: The target calls metadata getters after setting PNG input. Their chunk-reading path calls read_non_idat_chunks, where the changed eXIf check resides; EEXIF has a nonstrict ancillary discard route.
